critical_code_review_comments: routes/payments.py — clean mock/live split, PayTR hash+token flow follows spec, callback verifies MERCHANT hash properly. Havale flow persists order to db.payments with status awaiting_transfer→paid via /havale/approve. Good.

routes/maintenance.py — cleanup correctly restricts targets to DATA_COLS whitelist so even if caller passes 'licenses' or 'settings' in collections list, they are filtered out. Confirm='DELETE_DATA' is enforced. maintenance_log entry created for audit trail. Perfect defensive design.

routes/maintenance.py db_usage classifies each collection as data/settings/other and returns will_delete + will_preserve arrays so UI can render the confirmation modal deterministically. Good UX contract.

routes/maintenance.py ip/status resolves country via routes.security_adv._ip_to_country (/8 map) — best-effort but works for the common Vultr/DO ranges. Blocking upserts into both `lists` (kind=blacklist) and `threat_iocs` — good, so ingest-time enforcement picks it up.
MailEventDetail SenderIPPanel uses api.ipStatus on drawer open and api.ipBlock/ipUnblock on button click — verified in DOM: shows 🇧🇷 flag + 'Brezilya · 3 mail · 3 spam' + IP + two buttons. Good.

Maintenance.js modal is properly gated: 'EVET, SIL' button stays disabled until typed value === 'SIL'. Verified in screenshot; matches server-side confirm='DELETE_DATA' requirement (naming inconsistency between UI text and API param is intentional — UI is Turkish, API is English constant).

Landing PaymentOptions component renders both PayTR (Kartla Öde) tab and Havale/EFT tab; PayTR tab shows amber notice 'PayTR test modunda. Canlı kullanım için MERCHANT bilgileri gereklidir.' which is honest and correct given .env keys not configured.

routes/events.py test-ingest produces 5 samples with subjects containing full Turkish diacritics (ACİL, Nijeryalı, kahve içelim, doğrulayın, indirim) — verified via GET /events. Sender_ip populated per event. Encoding preserved through MongoDB round-trip.
